_published_faq.name: How do I add MercadoLibre to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MercadoLibre to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mercadolibre.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MercadoLibre MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MercadoLibre provides these MCP tools: search_documentation and get_documentation_page.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MercadoLibre?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MercadoLibre in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
MercadoLibre requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MercadoLibre is developed by Mercado Libre. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
